title: test_presence_cache: no test for max_entries=0 or negative
description: PresenceCacheResource accepts max_entries=0 and negative values without validation. With max_entries=0, entries are immediately evicted after recording (cache is useless). With negative values, behavior is undefined. Tests should verify either (1) invalid values raise ValueError, or (2) behavior is well-defined and documented. File: python/tests/coap/test_presence_cache.py, TestPresenceCacheMaxEntries class.
